biotools.summary: InstaPrism is an R package that implements a fixed-point algorithm to accelerate BayesPrism, a Bayesian approach to computational cell-type deconvolution. It enhances speed and memory efficiency while maintaining accuracy compared to the original method and comes with precompiled reference sets for cancer types.
